subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supply Chain Visibility
description: Learn Supply Chain Visibility in one minute.

hook.text: A container is stuck in a port somewhere. Nobody knows where, which container, or what's inside. That's the problem.

buildup.text: Visibility means knowing in real time where goods are, what condition they're in, and when they'll arrive.

discovery.text: IoT sensors, GPS trackers, and control towers provide end-to-end tracking from factory to customer.

twist.text: Technology exists. The problem is getting every partner in the chain to share data and connect systems.

climax.text: Companies with end-to-end visibility detect disruptions 3–5x faster and resolve them before customers notice.

punchline.text: See the problem first. Fix it before it arrives.

quiz.question: How much faster do companies with visibility detect disruptions?
